description:
Building features on the hotel contract and availability engine: seasons, rates, allotments, promotions and cancel rules
Writing and maintaining supplier connections (SOAP and REST) and the partner API
Building screens in our React back office for DMCs and tour operators
Writing functional tests for every change and every bug fix
Watching production in Datadog and fixing what breaks, with the rest of the team
Reviewing merge requests, guiding design choices and keeping the code clean as the product grows
Problems you'll work on:
AI inside the platform. A key goal is to make Koob easier to use through AI. Our MCP server already lets AI agents search hotels, load contracts and book. Next come features such as RAG over our hotel and destination content, and assistants that help DMCs and tour operators get work done faster.
Fast availability across suppliers. Room searches fan out to several hotel suppliers and our own contracts. We keep them fast with a shared Redis cache and an Elasticsearch read model that must stay in sync with PostgreSQL.
A pricing engine with real rules. Seasons, weekday rules, promotions, extra beds and cancel rules all combine into one price, rounded to 2 decimals and identical on every path.
Supplier connections. SOAP and REST integrations where each supplier shapes its data a little differently. We clean and check it where it enters the system.
A versioned partner API. Three live API versions that partners depend on.
Reliable background work. Imports, syncs and emails run as jobs on Cloud Tasks, with retries and alerts when they fail.

Software design skills: you shape data models, API contracts and module boundaries that still hold a year later
UI/UX design skills: we have no dedicated designer, so you design clear, usable screens yourself, from a rough idea to a finished page
5+ years building full stack web apps in production with TypeScript and Node.js or similar technologies
Strong SQL
Hands-on React experience
You write tests without being asked
Good written and spoken English: we work with international companies
Able to work alone and ask for help early

Experience building LLM features: MCP servers, RAG, embeddings, prompt design and evaluation
Travel industry experience (hotel contracts, bed banks, GDS, channel managers)
NestJS, an ORM such as MikroORM or TypeORM
Elasticsearch knowledge
Google Cloud, Terraform, Datadog

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - AI Solutions
company: Công Ty Cổ Phần Truyền Thông Square
locations_raw: ["54-56 Hoa Đào, phường 2, Phú Nhuận, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam"]
description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a hands-on, business-facing builder who sits at the intersection of AI and the agency business. Rather than building software in isolation, the FDE is embedded directly with the teams of Square Group's member companies - event, activation, production and digital communication - to understand how work is really done, identify where AI can create measurable value, and rapidly design, build and deploy AI-powered solutions (agents, automated workflows, integrations and internal tools) into daily operations.
The role holder combines the skills of an engineer, a solution consultant and a project lead: translating business pain points into working prototypes within days, taking proven solutions to production, driving user adoption, and turning successful one-off solutions into reusable assets for the whole Group.
Prior experience in an agency / marcom environment is a significant advantage, as the FDE must speak the language of account, creative, production and finance teams as fluently as the language of code and data.
KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Embed with Agency Teams & Discover Use Cases
- Work side-by-side with account, creative, production, finance and back-office teams of member companies to map workflows and identify high-impact AI opportunities.
- Define problem statements, success metrics and expected ROI with business owners, and prioritize the use-case backlog.
2. Build & Deploy AI Solutions
- Rapidly prototype with LLMs, AI agents, automation/low-code tools and custom code, then turn validated prototypes into reliable production solutions.
- Integrate AI into the tools teams already use (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, finance/project systems) with human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive outputs.
3. Data & Integration
- Structure and connect agency knowledge and data (rate cards, quotations, case studies, supplier lists, SOPs) via APIs, connectors and scripts, ensuring data confidentiality.
4. Governance & Security
- Work closely with Group IT to ensure every solution complies with the Group information security policy and personal data protection regulations (access control, data classification, approved tools).
- Document each production solution and agree on clear ownership and maintenance arrangements before handover, avoiding unmanaged "shadow IT" tools.
5. Adoption & Enablement
- Onboard and train users, build AI champions in each agency, and communicate results clearly to management and staff.
6. Measurement & Productization
- Track the impact of each deployment against agreed KPIs and turn proven solutions into reusable assets for the whole Group.
- Indicative KPIs include: number of use cases taken to production per quarter, working hours saved, user adoption rate, and number of AI champions trained per member company.
requirements:
Must-have
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data/Business Analytics, Marketing/Communications or equivalent practical experience.
- Minimum of 3-5 years' experience in a hands-on technical role (software/full-stack, data, automation, AI or solution engineering), OR in a business/operations role with a proven track record of building automation and AI solutions.
- Proven portfolio of AI/Automation solutions that were actually deployed and used by real users (please share links, demos or case studies).
- Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (prompting, tool calling), Python or JavaScript, APIs and at least one automation platform (n8n, Make, Apps Script or similar).
- Good data skills (spreadsheets, SQL, data structuring) and working knowledge of Google Workspace / Microsoft 365.
- Consulting mindset and strong stakeholder management: able to turn business processes into clear solutions and present ROI convincingly to C-level in a fast-paced agency environment.
- Ownership, speed and curiosity about AI; high integrity and confidentiality; fluent Vietnamese and good English.
Nice-to-have
- Experience working in an agency - Marcom, event, activation, production or digital communication - (in-house or client-facing); understanding of the agency workflow (brief - pitch - quotation - production - execution - recap - billing, finance and back-office operations) is highly valued.
- Experience with RAG, MCP, vector databases or AI agents running in production.
- Experience training end users and driving adoption of new tools or processes.
WHAT WE OFFER
- The opportunity to shape AI transformation across 8 member companies of Square Group, with direct access to CEOs and senior leadership.
- Autonomy to choose tools and approaches, with a budget for AI tools and subscriptions.
- Competitive salary package commensurate with experience, and benefits in line with Group policy.
- Clear career path to Lead level as the Group AI capability grows.
SELECTION PROCESS
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a practical case: propose and demo a quick solution for a real agency workflow (e.g. turning a client brief into a draft quotation).

HARTING Technology Group is a German industrial technology corporation, founded in 1945, and today stands as one of the world’s leading providers of industrial connectivity solutions. With more than 6,200 employees working across 43 sales companies, 14 production facilities, and 6 R&D sites worldwide, HARTING delivers advanced technologies that enable the reliable transmission of data, signals, and power across diverse industrial sectors.
In Vietnam, we have a production facility located in Hai Phong (former Hai Duong) and a R&D Center in Hanoi.
Now we offer you an opportunity to become a Master Data Management Specialist
at HARTING Vietnam
-----------------------------
Job Description
The
Master Data Management Specialist
will assist in defining and implementing global master data rules while acting as a "gatekeeper" to ensure compliance with our data governance standards. This entry-level position involves the creation and maintenance of master data, as well as supporting data operations under the supervision of senior data management professionals.
Responsibilities:
- Define Global Master Data Rules:
Support in the creation, documentation and optimisation of globally valid master data rules.
- Gatekeeper for Master Data:
Monitoring the rules and checking the plausibility of the creation of new master data with the aim of ensuring data consistency and accuracy.
- Compliance with Master Data Governance:
Assist in monitoring compliance with master data governance rules using appropriate analytics tools and KPI-based optimisation of master data.
- Master Data Creation:
Creation of new master data in new product projects (NP projects), business operations accounts (BOAs), change requests (CR), relocations and duplication projects.
- Knowledge Assurance & Documentation:
Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation on master data processes, rules and governance including ensuring knowledge of team members and interfaces.
requirements:

- From 3 years of experiences in master data management
- Working with SAP is a plus
- Understanding of master data management principles and data governance best practices.
- Strong attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining data accuracy and quality.
- Good English communication skills, both verbal and written

- 13th‑month salary + MBO bonus
- Monday–Friday working schedule, WFH and flexible working hours
- Opportunities for overseas training
- Annual company trip, parties, and various internal activities
- Birthday gifts/cash and holiday bonuses
- Free lunch at the company
- Company shuttle bus from Hanoi, Hung Yen, and Hai Phong to the factory
- European working environment with an open and inclusive culture
